title: chore: defect hunt (11-04 #18): file 2-4 evidence-backed bug rows from the pending daemon swap's startup path (migrations, backfills, heal, restart purge and reattach on today's .moe/), the wrapper side of Claude account rotation, and the metrics surfaces (list_metrics, task metrics stamping, the analyze/usage/baseline scripts)
description:
Filed by the governor (governor-e6142a94) on 2026-11-04, after hunt #17 closed.

WHY. At filing time 1 architect and 2 workers are idle. The board holds 3 PLANNING rows (all claimed), 2 WORKING, 3 in REVIEW and 1 BACKLOG row that is dependency-gated, so it drains in about 30-40 min without new rows.

LANE. Search in this order of preference:
1. The pending live-daemon swap's startup path. The human is due to swap the live daemon from edc27e14 (pid 36176) to the staged build of 2a1c5a36 at D:\projexts\moe-rebuild-2a1c5a36, which is 80 DONE daemon commits newer.
   - Audit what that daemon does to THIS board's .moe/ at its first start: src/migrations (v1_to_v2 .. v5_to_v6), src/state/backfills, legacyTaskBackfill, massDeletionHeal, and the restart purge and reattach (purgeAllWorkers, the held-seat reattach, attempt and lease records).
   - Look for a record written by edc27e14 that the new daemon misreads, drops, resets or rewrites at startup: tasks, attempts, workers, resources/leases, receipts, chat cursors or proposals.
   - Method: boot the staged build on a COPY of today's .moe/, the way /mnt/d/moe-scratch/governor/smoke-daemon.ps1 does (its own port, isolated HOME). Diff the records before and after the boot, and compare the same boot of an edc27e14 build.
   - HARD LIMITS: never build, npm ci or test inside D:\projexts\moe-rebuild-2a1c5a36, because it is the swap target. Never point a second daemon at the live .moe/. Never stop or signal pid 36176 or its supervisor. Make your own clone or snapshot for any build.
2. The wrapper side of Claude account rotation: scripts/moe-account-lease.mjs, usage-session.mjs, usage-receipt.mjs, usage-report.mjs, prompt-cache*.mjs, and the moe-account-switch mod in scripts/mods. Hunt #13 covered only the daemon side.
   - Today's switch is a live sample. acct-1 reached 91% and the 06:40Z #governors banner moved every seat to acct-2; compare the logs and the lease files against what those scripts claim.
   - Look for a lease never released, two seats on one lease, a switch decided on stale usage, or a seat left on a spent account.
   - Do not edit or re-lease the live accounts file (~/.moe/claude-accounts.json); read it, or use MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE pointed at a copy.
3. The metrics surfaces: moe.list_metrics; the task metrics stamping (firstClaimAt, plannedStepCount, plannedDistinctFileCount, executedStepCount, wallClockMs, doneAt) across reopen, release, re-claim, the landing-retry route and BLOCKED; and scripts/analyze-task-metrics.mjs, analyze-usage.mjs and baseline-*.mjs run read-only against a copy of today's .moe/. Look for a count that goes wrong after a reopen or release, or a script that crashes or misreports on today's record shapes (worktree-mode records, ARCHIVED rows, 1000+ tasks).

SKIP.
- The lanes of hunts #1-#17 (read the archived hunt-row titles) and every row filed on 11-03 or 11-04 (grep .moe/tasks first).
- Every file an open row holds. Run `node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/governor/lanes.js -v` when you start. At filing time those are:
  - scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1}, scripts/CLAUDE.md and docs/plans/2026-10-30-per-task-worktrees.md;
  - scripts/tests/{postflight-fake-proxy.js, postflight-owner-scope.test.mjs, postflight-worktree.cjs, postflight-vm-route.ps1, parity-check.sh, parity-check.ps1};
  - docs/roles/{governor,worker,architect}.reference.md and packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts;
  - packages/moe-daemon/src/commands/{doctor.test.ts, doctorWorktree.ts} and docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md;
  - once their plans land: index.ts and its test (78fa7110), the JetBrains daemon supervisor and models files (fe811130, 8383080c), and doctor.ts (d7b24cab).
  - docs/MCP_SERVER.md is shared by section (ruling msg-71db57ac).
- The verified-local profile is refused by design, so a gap there counts only if it affects the legacy profile.

EVIDENCE BAR. Same as hunts #2-#17. One of:
- a repro on HEAD 821478d6 or later, run in a snapshot outside the shared checkout (never build or test in place; the shared checkout's packages/moe-daemon/dist is the live runtime);
- a failure line from today's logs;
- a doc/code file:line pair with a call or test that shows the difference.
No speculative or style-only findings.

OUTPUT AND HOW TO FINISH. This row produces no code and no plan, so do not call moe.submit_plan.
1. File each finding with moe.create_task in the epic that owns the code, status PLANNING. Add no dependsOn unless a real logic edge exists; a shared file gets a placement note instead. Give each row a problem statement, the evidence, a fix direction and 2-3 checkable DoD items.
2. A lane-1 finding that should hold the swap goes in #governors at once with an @governor-e6142a94 mention, before you file anything else.
3. Post the ids, or "nothing real", in #governors and mention governor-e6142a94.
4. Archive this row yourself with moe.archive_task.
definitionOfDone: 2-4 new bug rows are filed in the epics that own the code, or "nothing real" is posted. Either way, the outcome is posted in #governors with a mention of governor-e6142a94, and any lane-1 finding that should hold the daemon swap is posted first.

Every filed row cites its evidence: a repro on HEAD 821478d6 or later run outside the shared checkout, a failure line from today's logs, or a doc/code file:line pair with a call or test that shows the difference. The staged swap build, the live .moe/, the live daemon and the live accounts file were never modified.
No filed row targets a file an open row holds (per lanes.js at hunt time) or duplicates a row filed on 11-03 or 11-04. The holder archives this row once the ids are posted.
